thread:
oliver: Heads up — new hires hit multiple quickstart copy/paste problems in the onboarding lab today.
oliver: Two main things: the curl example uses backslash line continuations (breaks in PowerShell) and the examples use mixed env var names (`REDWOOD_KEY` vs `REDWOOD_API_KEY`).
oliver: Broken curl from README pasted into PowerShell -> `curl: (6) Could not resolve host: -H`.

rachel: Oof. Can you paste the snippet you saw?

oliver: Sure — pasted exactly from docs: 
```
curl \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

jake: Two quick fixes: (1) make the README show a single-line curl (portable), (2) add a PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod example, and (3) pick a canonical env var name and update all language samples.

jake: Proposed single-line curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

jake: PowerShell variant to add:
```
$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"; "Content-Type" = "application/json" }
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -Method Post -Headers $headers -Body '{"input":"test"}'
```

rachel: Also, TypeScript README shows `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` which fails if folks have `esModuleInterop: false`. We should show both patterns and a note.

oliver: Good call. Could we also add a tiny docs smoke test in CI that runs a small node script from docs/examples to catch regressions?

jake: I'll open a PR to normalize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, update curl/PowerShell snippets, add the TS import variants, and drop a quickstart-smoke.js that reads process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY and prints a short success message.
jake: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 (draft) — includes smoke script and updates.
docs-bot: CI note: added docs smoke stage (docs:smoke) to run node examples if REDWOOD_API_KEY set in CI secrets.
rachel: Thanks. After the PR lands let's run through the onboarding guide to ensure the lab instructions align (env var name, how to set on mac/linux/windows).
oliver: Will do. Happy to review the PR. :thumbsup:
